purpose: Preflight and exponent ledger for the cheapest currently credible discriminator of the retained-hat DPA route. This file does not assert the theorem.

root_boundary.immediate_parent: positive-direction DPA for the fixed retained adjacent-gap hat
root_boundary.would_close_if_proved: the fixed-hat positive DPA candidate for every c < 19/1000, after the recorded tail and persistence adapters

object.construction: Start with the adjacent-prime-gap logarithmic hat. Delete both endpoint shares contributed by every physical prime gap g > Y^theta, then normalize the retained nonnegative weights to total mass one.
object.polynomial: F_{Y,theta}(t) = sum_p lambda_p exp(i t log(p/Y))
object.quantifiers: For every sufficiently large admissible Y, uniformly over the full indicated t interval; the coefficients are the one fixed arithmetic vector above, not arbitrary coefficients.

target_theorem.name: GCG4(161/1000, 3/8)
target_theorem.statement: Integral from L to 2B of |F_{Y,theta}(t)|^4 dt is at most Y^(13/8 - 2q + o(1)), equivalently at most Y^(-1187/13000 + o(1)).
target_theorem.conductor_gain: rho = 3/8 relative to the generic Y^2 conductor term
target_theorem.endpoint_note: The upper endpoint is 2B so the one-sided persistence interval remains inside the controlled range even when the violating point lies at B.

adapter.full_to_retained_tail: The deleted mass and normalization error are O(Y^(-s+epsilon)); since s > c, a full-hat violation below -Y^(-c) transfers to a retained real-part violation below a fixed fraction of that level.
adapter.persistence: Because |F''(t)| <= sum lambda_p |log(p/Y)|^2 <= w^2, choose the direction opposite the first derivative. A negative sublevel of depth comparable to delta persists for length Omega(sqrt(delta)).
adapter.moment_consequence: One violation forces fourth-moment mass Omega(delta^(9/2)). The strict ledger margin contradicts GCG4.
adapter.why_not_target_renaming: The theorem is a conventional polynomial fourth moment, controls both signs and complex peaks, and is strictly stronger than the one-sided floor actually needed. Its downstream implication is recorded separately.

arithmetic_reduction.easy_sectors: The exact diagonal and all square-containing/shared-prime sectors are bounded on the required scale by (T+Y)(sum lambda_p^2)^2.
arithmetic_reduction.first_open_core: At the top scale T=B, bound the four-distinct off-diagonal contribution 4T sum_{p<r,q<s; {p,r} cap {q,s}=empty} lambda_p lambda_r lambda_q lambda_s K_psi(T log(pr/qs)) by Y^(13/8-2q+o(1)).
arithmetic_reduction.top_resolution: H = Y^(16/33) = M^(8/33) for M asymptotic to Y^2.
arithmetic_reduction.logical_caution: Success at T=B does not settle all lower t windows; failure for the actual fixed weights kills this GCG4 route.

licensed_falsifiers.abstract: A coefficient-uniform or arbitrary-subset version is false: a supported subset may be selected to align at one legal phase.
licensed_falsifiers.fejer: Replacing the translated kernel by a positive/absolute close-pair majorant restores the generic Y^2 conductor term, so positivity alone misses the requested Y^(3/8) gain.
licensed_falsifiers.prime_density_pseudonodes: Odd-half-grid and exact-log prime-density pseudo-node constructions preserve coarse density and short gaps while creating a constant antipodal peak; actual primality/selector structure is indispensable.
licensed_falsifiers.finite_evidence: Only the four already frozen actual vectors and their frozen controls may be replayed. They can falsify a finite normalization or expose resonance, but cannot prove or refute the asymptotic theorem unless accompanied by a rigorous transferable mechanism.

fast_falsifiers: Do not seek a coefficient-uniform theorem: phase-aligned supported subsets give counterexamples.
Check the top-window four-distinct sector before attempting all-window machinery.
Replay only the already preregistered finite centers and controls; label it FLOAT-SCOUT and draw no asymptotic conclusion.
Abort if the exact retained vector is not used, if an absolute close-pair bound discards its arithmetic structure, or if the imported theorem's coefficient class does not match.
Keep the positive-DPA, negative-DPA, LTRAD, strip, and RH gates separate.

literature_fit_at_preflight.matomaki_radziwill_tao_2017: The M^(8/33+epsilon) threshold is numerically aligned with the top resolution, but the theorem concerns natural Lambda/divisor correlations and does not directly accept the fixed translated retained weights.
literature_fit_at_preflight.matomaki_teravainen_2022: Its absolute close-pair treatment loses the sign/translation structure needed here.
literature_fit_at_preflight.guth_maynard_2024: The nominal exponent is relevant, but no verified l2-sensitive fixed-vector specialization currently supplies this moment.
literature_fit_at_preflight.higher_uniformity_ii_2024: The available saving and dense divisor-type setting do not match the requested sparse weighted estimate.
literature_fit_at_preflight.status: No literature import presently closes GCG4.

finite_replay.allowed_data: Only the four frozen centers and controls in zeta23_ht_hat_prereg_v1.json and its corresponding diagnostic artifact.
finite_replay.primary_statistic: Numerically integrate |F|^4 on [L,2B] for the exactly reconstructed retained vector and compare with (B+Y^(13/8))(sum lambda_p^2)^2; also report retention mass/count.
finite_replay.interpretation: A bounded sanity/falsification probe only. Finite success is not evidence of an asymptotic theorem; catastrophic structured growth or a broken retention regime is actionable negative information.

stop_rules.success: An exact proof of GCG4 with all coefficient, smoothing, endpoint, and lower-window hypotheses matched; then run the recorded adapter as a separate theorem.
stop_rules.route_failure: A rigorous lower bound for the actual retained weights exceeding the target, or a verified structural obstruction showing the four-distinct core cannot have rho=3/8.
stop_rules.inconclusive: Literature mismatch, finite-range behavior, or top-window success alone; record the residual rather than upgrading status.
